import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, bottom, length, ne;
        Edge(int to, int bottom, int length, int ne) {
            this.to = to;
            this.bottom = bottom;
            this.length = length;
            this.ne = ne;
        }
    }

    static final int max_size = 55;
    static final int max_time = 2 * max_size;
    static final int max_points = max_time * max_size;
    static final int max_edges = 5 * max_time * max_size * max_size;
    static final int infinity = (int)1e9;

    static char get_char(BufferedReader br, StringTokenizer st) throws IOException {
        if (!st.hasMoreTokens()) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            if (line == null) return (char) -1;
            st = new StringTokenizer(line);
        }
        String token = st.nextToken();
        if (token.length() == 1) return token.charAt(0);
        return (char) -1;
    }

    static long read_long(BufferedReader br, StringTokenizer st) throws IOException {
        while (!st.hasMoreTokens()) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            if (line == null) return 0;
            st = new StringTokenizer(line);
        }
        return Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
    }

    static int[] edgesTo = new int[max_edges];
    static int[] edgesBottom = new int[max_edges];
    static int[] edgesLength = new int[max_edges];
    static int[] edgesNe = new int[max_edges];
    static int edgeCount = 1;
    static int[] head = new int[max_points];
    static int total_nodes, N, M, K, C, D, point_count;
    static int[][] node_id = new int[max_size][max_time];
    static int start_node = 1, end_node = 2, point_count_global = 2;
    static boolean[] visited = new boolean[max_points];
    static int[] dist = new int[max_points];
    static int total_cost = 0;
    static int total_flow = 0;
    static Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();

    static void add_edge(int a, int b, int c, int l) {
        edgesTo[++edgeCount] = b;
        edgesBottom[edgeCount] = l;
        edgesLength[edgeCount] = c;
        edgesNe[edgeCount] = head[a];
        head[a] = edgeCount;
    }

    static void add_bidirectional_edge(int a, int b, int c, int l) {
        add_edge(a, b, c, l);
        add_edge(b, a, -c, 0);
    }

    static boolean spfa() {
        Arrays.fill(visited, false);
        Arrays.fill(dist, infinity);
        dist[start_node] = 0;
        q.clear();
        q.add(start_node);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int p = q.poll();
            visited[p] = false;
            for (int i = head[p]; i != 0; i = edgesNe[i]) {
                if (edgesBottom[i] == 0) continue;
                int b = edgesTo[i];
                if (dist[b] > dist[p] + edgesLength[i]) {
                    dist[b] = dist[p] + edgesLength[i];
                    if (!visited[b]) {
                        q.add(b);
                        visited[b] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[end_node] < infinity;
    }

    static int dinic(int x, int flow) {
        if (x == start_node) return flow;
        visited[x] = true;
        int remaining = flow;
        for (int i = head[x]; i != 0; i = edgesNe[i]) {
            int b = edgesTo[i];
            if (visited[b] || edgesBottom[i] == 0 || dist[x] < dist[b] + edgesLength[i ^ 1]) continue;
            int pushed = dinic(b, Math.min(remaining, edgesBottom[i]));
            if (pushed > 0) {
                edgesBottom[i] -= pushed;
                edgesBottom[i ^ 1] += pushed;
                remaining -= pushed;
                if (remaining == 0) break;
            }
        }
        return flow - remaining;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = (int) read_long(br, st);
        M = (int) read_long(br, st);
        K = (int) read_long(br, st);
        C = (int) read_long(br, st);
        D = (int) read_long(br, st);
        int[] cnt = new int[max_size];
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            int val = (int) read_long(br, st);
            cnt[val]++;
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= K + M + 2; j++) {
                node_id[i][j] = ++point_count_global;
                if (i == 1) add_edge(node_id[i][j], end_node, C * (j - 1), infinity);
                if (j > 1) add_edge(node_id[i][j - 1], node_id[i][j], 0, infinity);
            }
            if (cnt[i] > 0) {
                add_edge(start_node, node_id[i][1], 0, cnt[i]);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= M; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int a = (int) read_long(br, st);
            int b = (int) read_long(br, st);
            for (int j = 1; j <= K + M + 1; j++) {
                for (int k = 1; k <= 2 * K - 1; k += 2) {
                    add_edge(node_id[a][j], node_id[b][j + 1], k * D, 1);
                    add_edge(node_id[b][j], node_id[a][j + 1], k * D, 1);
                }
            }
        }
        total_flow = 0;
        while (spfa()) {
            int flow_value = -1;
            while (flow_value != 0) {
                Arrays.fill(visited, false);
                flow_value = dinic(end_node, infinity);
                if (flow_value > 0) {
                    total_flow += flow_value;
                    total_cost += dist[end_node] * flow_value;
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(total_cost);
    }
}
